_why: Who made the page and for whom: shown on every map and chart page (byline, logos, GitHub), and where pages are published (github.pages_repo). The WRI team defaults; a personal copy at ~/.config/wri-html-pages/identity.json wins. Owner, 2026-10-12. Pages pick changes up when rebuilt; a page can override the author.
author: Carlo Broderick

orgs.name: National Center for Ecological Analysis and Synthesis

page_icon._why: Every page carries the WRI flame (the wildfireindex.org favicon, no hexagon border) as its browser-tab icon and as the preview image when its link is pasted into Slack, email or social media. Previews need a public absolute URL, so the image is hosted on the pages site.
